reason: Payment split allocates exactly the full $128 gift-card balance to a $299 fare, but the policy does not authorize exhausting the gift card (or the certificate is being skipped correctly per the $400 rule only if such a rule exists); more concretely, there is no visible rule requiring using a payment under $400 to avoid the certificate, and using a gift card plus credit card is permitted, so the main risk is that the booking fails on API/booking-side validation such as using the same gift card that may have been fully used previously (reservation G72NSF payment history shows gift_card_8516878 charged $658) while the profile still shows $128, an inconsistency that could cause a failed task.
